question: Hair sources spike: all styles are done except dreads and braided beards. For those, I found four Fab packs (2 dread, 2 braided beard), but Fab hides their price and licence unless you are logged in, and Sketchfab blocks agents (403). Without a read licence, the runbook marks them refused. Authoring them ourselves already has a costed row: UMA Hair Card Editor or Blender, free, about 6-10 h for dreads and more for beard braids on a CC0 beard. How should I close these two styles?

options.label: Accept authoring
options.answer: Owner 2026-10-23: accept authoring (UMA Hair Card Editor / Blender) as the candidate for dreads and braided or dreaded beards; keep the Fab packs listed as refused pending licence; close the spike.
options.note: No purchase. Dreads and braided beard are authored in-house (about 6-10 h each) when imported

options.label: I'll read Fab prices
options.answer: Owner 2026-10-23: I will read the four Fab listings myself and paste price and licence here; wait for them.
options.note: The task waits until you paste the price and licence for the 4 Fab links in the README

options.label: Drop these two styles
options.answer: Owner 2026-10-23: drop dreads and braided beards from this spike; mark them out of scope in the README and close.
options.note: The creator ships with no dreads and no braided beard for now

title: Spike: sources for dreads, braids, curls, afro, updo, masculine long hair and braided beards on UMA
